summary: Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share, a $0.05 increase from the prior $0.20, payable May 12, 2026 to record holders on May 1, 2026. No advisor or recommendation was mentioned. The filing is a routine dividend increase signaling capital return to shareholders. This is a capital return event and not a special situation; watch for future dividend policy or share buyback announcements.
